h: CBN approves new non-interest bank, Milestone Global Bank
p: The Central Bank of Nigeria has reportedly given final approval to Milestone Global Bank to operate as a regional non-interest bank. It will compete with lenders such as Jaiz Bank, TAJBank and Lotus Bank.
body: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) has reportedly granted final regulatory approval to Milestone Global Bank Limited to operate as a regional non-interest bank.
The approval is said to follow the bank's compliance with regulatory requirements on minimum capital, corporate governance and non-interest banking operations.
In a statement on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, the bank said it was finalising arrangements to begin operations, and plans to serve customers through both digital platforms and physical branches.
The new lender will compete with established non-interest banks and other alternative banking providers, including Jaiz Bank, TAJBank and Lotus Bank.
more: Milestone Global Bank will operate regionally.
It plans digital and branch services.
It joins Jaiz, TAJBank and Lotus Bank in the sector.
